about.title: About Kaituo Longhai
overview: Qingdao Kaituo Longhai Intelligent Control Co., Ltd. was founded on March 29, 2002. After more than 20 years of dedicated operation, it has developed into a high-tech and high value-added enterprise specializing in the manufacture of refrigeration system components. The company's R&D center is recognized as a city-level enterprise technology center in Qingdao and has also established a university-enterprise joint R&D platform with Shandong University and Shandong University of Science and Technology.

To support business growth, in August 2021 the company commissioned a modern manufacturing campus at No. 21 Xiangjiang Road in the SCO Demonstration Zone, Jiaozhou, Qingdao, covering 51,000 sqm with 43,000 sqm of building area and registered capital of 20 million CNY.

founder.salutation: Dear friends and members of the Kaituo Longhai family,
paragraphs: Since the day Kaituo Longhai was founded, we have put customers first and quality as our foundation, with unity and enterprise as the spirit that drives our innovation and growth. We opened a new chapter in our blueprint with vigour and speed. After more than twenty years of development, Kaituo Longhai today has a broad base of quality customers and reliable products—this is the result of everyone at Kaituo Longhai working together. Yet competition in the industry is fiercer, and technology is changing rapidly; the road ahead will be harder and steeper. We must see clearly the challenges of the market and our own gaps, face the future, and win it.

In the future, Kaituo Longhai will become a “school”: I hope every member of Kaituo Longhai, while creating economic value at work, will study and learn diligently, and raise their cultural and professional competence, to achieve the great goal of growing together with the company.

I believe that through our shared effort and perseverance, we will surely make Kaituo Longhai’s future bright and glorious! I wish to build, together with all of you, with the firm conviction of “building great enterprise with benevolence, shaping the world with discipline”—a better future for Kaituo Longhai!

receivers.title: Receiver Series
receivers.subtitle: Specializing in all kinds of refrigeration system receivers, ensuring stable refrigerant supply and providing solutions for all sizes.
receivers.overview: Our receiver products are made of high-quality materials, with excellent liquid storage performance and stable pressure control. Widely used in residential, commercial, and industrial refrigeration systems, providing reliable refrigerant storage solutions for customers.

products.name: R-001 Vertical Receiver
products.description: Suitable for small and medium refrigeration systems, with excellent storage and stable pressure control.

products.name: R-002 Horizontal Receiver
products.description: Designed for large commercial refrigeration systems, offering larger capacity and more stable performance.

products.name: R-003 High-Pressure Receiver
products.description: Professional receiver for high-pressure applications, suitable for industrial refrigeration and special environments.

products.name: R-004 Compact Receiver
products.description: Miniature design, suitable for applications with limited space, without sacrificing performance.

products.name: R-005 Smart Receiver
products.description: Integrated smart monitoring for real-time monitoring of liquid status and system parameters.

products.name: R-006 Eco-friendly Receiver
products.description: Uses environmentally friendly materials and processes, meeting the latest green standards, suitable for green buildings.

applications.residentialDesc: Suitable for home split units, central refrigeration and other small systems.
applications.commercialDesc: Ideal for shopping malls, office buildings, hotels, and other commercial AC systems.
applications.industrialDesc: Used in large refrigeration systems such as industrial cold storage and refrigeration equipment.

gasLiquidSeparators.title: Gas-Liquid Separator Series
gasLiquidSeparators.subtitle: Efficiently separates gas-liquid mixtures, improving refrigeration system efficiency and ensuring stable operation.
gasLiquidSeparators.overview: Our gas-liquid separators use advanced separation technology to efficiently separate gas and liquid in refrigerants, ensuring compressor safety and improving the efficiency and reliability of the whole system.

products.name: GLS-001 High-Efficiency Separator
products.description: Uses advanced separation technology, ensuring separation efficiency of over 99.5%.

products.name: GLS-002 Compact Separator
products.description: Compact design for space-limited applications, outstanding performance.

products.name: GLS-003 Heavy Duty Industrial Separator
products.description: Designed for heavy industrial applications, with strong capacity and stability.

products.name: GLS-004 Smart Separator
products.description: Integrated smart monitoring for real-time monitoring of separation effect and equipment status.

advantages.efficientDesc: Separation efficiency up to 99.8%, ensuring efficient operation.
advantages.lowPressureDesc: Optimized flow path design to minimize pressure loss.
advantages.maintenanceDesc: Simple and reliable structure, no special maintenance required.
advantages.corrosionDesc: Made with premium stainless steel to adapt to various working environments.
